sources.title: OpenPI - Open Source Vision-Language-Action Model Library
sources.snippet: OpenPI Open Source Vision-Language-Action Model Library for Robotics Developed by the Physical Intelligence team, OpenPI hosts open-source VLA models pre-trained on 10k+ hours of robot data, enabling researchers and practitioners to fine-tune and deploy robotic manipulation capabilities across diverse platforms.
